scope: Maps open BD-queue states (BD_B01_B46 'state') to the BT intervention type whose observed strength sets their back-pressure weight.
admits: The mapping only. cpath.backpressure() still applies BT weights only when the BT frontier is PASS_OBSERVED_BT with at least min_bt_pairs (5) measured pairs, and the PCA WIP cap only with at least min_pca_rows (10) rows.
